purpose: Extracts matches or named groups from text given a regular expression pattern.
capability: Runs regex pattern matching across text input and returns all matches or captured groups.

output.matches: list of strings or dicts (if capturing groups)

interface: index.py -> extract_regex_pattern(text: str, pattern: str, flags: int = 0) -> dict
composition: Can be composed with read-file-content or search-text-pattern.
failure_behavior: Returns empty matches list on no match; raises re.error on invalid regex.
